outcome: A planeswalker card can be cast only from hand in a main phase of its owner's turn with an empty stack.
A resolving planeswalker spell enters the battlefield under its controller's control.
Two legendary planeswalkers with the same name are subject to the legend rule, so one goes to the graveyard.
A planeswalker enters with loyalty counters equal to its printed loyalty.
A planeswalker's loyalty on the battlefield equals its loyalty counters.
note: Continuous records do not report loyalty.

outcome: A loyalty ability can be activated only in a main phase of its controller's turn with an empty stack and only if none of that permanent's loyalty abilities was activated this turn.

note: Historical note about a removed redirection rule.

outcome: Damage dealt to a planeswalker removes that many loyalty counters from it.
A planeswalker with 0 loyalty moves to its owner's graveyard in the state-based check.
